title: MCP tool call authorization input
description: Normalized description of one MCP tools/call request. Version 1.x. Integrations build this document; policies read nothing else from the request.

version.description: Input schema version. Policies accept any 1.x version and deny anything else.

request_id.description: Correlation ID assigned by the integration.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 time the integration received the call. This is the only clock policies read, so decisions stay deterministic and testable. Time-based rules fail closed when it is missing or invalid.

principal.description: The human or service on whose behalf the call runs. Set by the integration from authenticated identity, never from the agent.

server.description: The MCP server receiving the call. The name is chosen by the integration's configuration, never by the agent.

tool.description: The tool being called. Annotations are self-reported by the server and may inform a deny but never grant access on their own.

arguments.description: The tool call arguments exactly as sent by the agent. Treat as untrusted.

labels.description: Free-form string labels. The only place for integration-specific values.
